name: nexus-wiki-html-preview
description: Wiki document block with left HTML editor and live preview

scripts.postinstall: (cd web/main && npm install) && (cd web/edit && npm install)
scripts.build-web: (cd web/main && npm run build) && (cd web/edit && npm run build)
scripts.start-web: concurrently -n view,edit "cd web/main && npm run start" "cd web/edit && npm run start"
